stories.title: Breezy Johnson wins gold, while Lindsey Vonn crash ends comeback quest
stories.summary: On the first Sunday of the Olympic Winter Games, downhill skier Breezy Johnson captured the first gold for Team USA. And alpine racer Lindsay Vonn crashed and was transported to the hospital with a broken leg.

stories.title: Investigating one of the worst train accidents in Spain's history
stories.summary: More than a week after one of the worst train accidents in Spain's history, many questions remain unanswered, and survivors struggle to move on.

stories.title: We're talking to you - Taxi Driver is 50
What does it mean when the president calls to "nationalize the voting"?
stories.summary: Wendy Weiser, the vice president for democracy at the Brennan Center for Justice, discusses the impact of President Trump's recent urging of Republicans to "nationalize" voting.

stories.title: How one New Hampshire town made sure its water was 'Safe to Drink'
stories.summary: NPR's Emily Kwong talks with Mara Hoplamazian about the new podcast, "Safe to Drink," about Merrimack, New Hampshire's fight for clean drinking water.

stories.title: The seismometers at the end of the earth have names
stories.summary: Scientists have placed two seismometers 8000 feet below the ice cap at the South Pole to measure earthquakes and support tsunami alerts.
